acceptance.given: A Candidate Package has been selected for a Matrix run with its candidate identity fixture and evaluated-change declaration available.

oracle.expected: The eligibility check recomputes Candidate content identity and verifies that the declared real change under evaluation is present in the executed Candidate Package.
forbidden: A Candidate Package that does not contain the real change under evaluation is accepted.
oracle.observable: The Candidate eligibility result binds the recomputed Candidate content identity to the evaluated-change containment check.

acceptance.then: Only a Candidate Package proven to contain the real evaluated change is eligible for Matrix execution.
acceptance.when: Candidate Package eligibility is evaluated before a Matrix run.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Use the existing candidate identity fixture with a Candidate workspace whose actual content omits the declared evaluated change; eligibility must reject the Candidate.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Candidate eligibility recomputes identity from the Candidate workspace and accepts it for Matrix execution only when its actual content contains the declared real change under evaluation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep the existing candidate identity fixture format; rollback removes only the containment enforcement and does not alter historical evidence or Candidate identity records.

slice_hint.state_transition: Candidate correspondence to the real evaluated change changes from unestablished to verified from executed Candidate content.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The Candidate is eligible only if recomputed Candidate content proves inclusion of the real evaluated change; otherwise eligibility fails and Matrix execution cannot use that Candidate.
